questions.stem: To grow, Oakridge Interiors, a small firm introduces its existing product line into a new country market for the first time. Which growth strategy is this?
questions.explanation: Market development means taking existing products into new markets, such as a new country or a new customer segment. Since the product is unchanged and only the market is new, this is market development. Penetration deepens the current market, product development creates new products, and diversification involves both new products and new markets.
questions.hint: Existing product, new market is market development.

options.misconception: assumes deeper sales in the current market
mistakes a single new market for an entirely new business
confuses a new market with a new product
